fact_text: To get an Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV), the relocating professional must hold a full-time job offer from an employer that is AEWV-accredited AND that already has an approved job check for that specific role.
evidence_quote: from an employer who is accredited to hire migrants for the Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) and has an approved job check for your job

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed any New Zealand job offer supports a work visa. Actually the AEWV requires the employer to already be accredited and to hold an approved job check for the exact role (which normally includes advertising to test for available New Zealanders). Action: confirm the employer's AEWV accreditation and job check before relying on the offer.

fact_text: The employer, not the migrant, carries the first compliance burden: a business must apply for and be granted AEWV employer accreditation before it can hire any migrant worker, then pass a job check for the role.
evidence_quote: If you want to hire migrant workers, you need to be an Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) accredited employer.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa process is entirely the employee's responsibility. Actually the employer must first obtain AEWV accreditation and an approved job check before the employee can even apply. Action: HR should verify or renew the company's accreditation early, as it gates the whole timeline.

entity_title: AEWV tied to employer and role
fact_text: An AEWV is tied to the specific employer, role and location approved in the job check. If any of these change, the holder must apply to vary their visa conditions, apply for a Job Change, or apply for a new visa before making the change.
evidence_quote: If your situation changes and you want to change your employer, job, location or a combination of these, you must apply to vary the conditions of your visa

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a work visa lets you switch jobs freely once you are in New Zealand. Actually the AEWV binds you to the approved employer, role and location; changing them without a variation or Job Change breaches your visa conditions. Action: apply for a Job Change before starting a new role or relocating.

fact_text: An AEWV holder may be able to support a visitor or work visa for their partner and a visitor or student visa for dependent children, allowing the family to join them in New Zealand.
evidence_quote: You may be able to support a visitor or work visa for your partner, and a visitor or student visa for your dependent children.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a work visa only covers the employee. Actually the AEWV holder can support a partner for a work visa and children for student visas, but this is conditional (partner work rights and children's school-fee status depend on the holder's role and pay). Action: check the partner-support wage threshold and dependants' rules before assuming family work or study rights.

fact_text: The pay test for a standard AEWV role is the New Zealand market rate, the range a New Zealander or resident would be paid for the job, rather than a single fixed national salary threshold.
evidence_quote: The New Zealand market rate is a range of pay that a New Zealander or resident would be paid within to do the job, or equivalent work.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the AEWV requires paying a fixed national 'median wage'. Actually the general median-wage pay threshold was removed and a standard AEWV role must be paid the New Zealand market rate for that job (above minimum wage). Action: benchmark the offer against the market-rate range for the occupation, not a single national figure.

fact_text: A relocating employee needs an IRD number, a unique tax identifier kept for life, before they can be paid correctly, open a bank account or join KiwiSaver. New arrivals can apply using their Immigration New Zealand visa details.
evidence_quote: You will need an IRD number for opening a bank account, joining KiwiSaver

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed tax paperwork can be sorted out later. Actually without an IRD number your employer must tax you at the highest 'no-declaration' rate, and you cannot open a bank account or join KiwiSaver. Action: apply for an IRD number as a 'new arrival' using your visa as soon as you land.

fact_text: If a new employee does not give their employer a completed IR330 tax code declaration (which requires their IRD number), the employer must deduct PAYE at the non-declaration rate of 45%.
evidence_quote: deduct tax from your pay at the non-declaration rate of 45%

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you are taxed correctly automatically from day one. Actually, without an IRD number and a completed IR330, your employer must deduct tax at the flat 45% non-declaration rate. Action: get your IRD number and give your employer a completed IR330 before your first payday.

fact_text: Tax residency is separate from immigration status. A relocated employee becomes a New Zealand tax resident, taxed on worldwide income, once present more than 183 days in any 12-month period, or once they have a permanent place of abode in New Zealand, whichever happens first.
evidence_quote: been in New Zealand for more than 183 days in any 12-month period

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed your tax obligations track your visa type. Actually tax residency is a separate test: 183 days' presence OR a permanent place of abode makes you a NZ tax resident on worldwide income, backdated to the first of the 183 days. Action: plan for NZ tax on global income once either test is met.

fact_text: A new migrant who becomes a NZ tax resident and was not resident in the previous 10 years automatically qualifies as a 'transitional resident', temporarily exempt from NZ tax on most foreign-source income (interest, dividends, rent, FIF income) for about 4 years. Overseas employment and personal-services income is NOT exempt.
evidence_quote: Transitional tax residents can be temporarily exempt from paying tax on most types of overseas income, even though you are a New Zealand tax resident.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed either all foreign income is taxed in NZ immediately, or all of it is exempt for 4 years. Actually most passive foreign income is exempt for about 4 years, but income earned overseas from employment or personal services is not exempt, and claiming Working for Families ends the exemption early. Action: do not claim Working for Families if you want to keep the exemption, and budget NZ tax on any foreign employment income.

fact_text: A relocated employee on a work visa is eligible for publicly funded health and disability services only if their visa lets them stay two years or more (counting time already spent lawfully in NZ before the visa). Those on shorter work visas are not eligible and are advised to hold health insurance.
evidence_quote: a work visa holder for 2 years or more (your work visa starts on your first day in New Zealand)

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed anyone legally working in NZ gets free public healthcare. Actually eligibility for publicly funded health services requires a work visa of two years or more; shorter-visa holders are not eligible. Action: if the initial AEWV is under two years, arrange private health insurance and keep your INZ immigration history as proof of eligibility.

fact_text: A relocated employee may keep driving on a valid overseas car licence for a limited period after arrival, then must convert it to a New Zealand licence or stop driving. From 1 November 2026 that period reduces from 18 to 12 months, and the clock restarts each time they leave and re-enter New Zealand.
evidence_quote: From 1 November 2026, the time you can drive on an overseas car licence in New Zealand will reduce from 18 months to 12 months from the day you last arrived in New Zealand.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed an overseas licence can be used indefinitely, or swapped instantly. Actually you may drive on it only for a limited window (12 months from 1 Nov 2026), then must convert or stop driving; drivers from non-exempt countries also face theory and practical tests. Action: book a conversion appointment early, as test slots can be scarce.

fact_text: Auto-enrolment into KiwiSaver does not apply to most relocated employees on an AEWV. To join, a person must be a New Zealand citizen or entitled to live in New Zealand indefinitely; temporary work-visa holders cannot join, so employer KiwiSaver contributions do not apply until they gain residence.
evidence_quote: You cannot join KiwiSaver if you have a temporary, visitor, work or student visa.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed every new employee is auto-enrolled into KiwiSaver from their first pay and receives employer contributions. Actually a work-visa holder is not eligible to join and is not auto-enrolled. Action: do not expect KiwiSaver employer contributions while on an AEWV; revisit once you hold residence.
